mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_risk (delivery_id, contract_id, risk_type, risk_level, risk_status, estimated_arrival_time, promised_delivery_date, production_need_date, impact_qty, impact_amount, risk_score, evidence, first_detected_time, due_time, owner_user_id) VALUES (#{deliveryId}, #{contractId}, #{riskType}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskStatus}, #{estimatedArrivalTime}, #{promisedDeliveryDate}, #{productionNeedDate}, #{impactQty}, #{impactAmount}, #{riskScore}, #{evidence}, #{firstDetectedTime}, #{dueTime}, #{ownerUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery_risk WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM delivery_risk WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND risk_status NOT IN ('closed') AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_risk SET risk_level = #{riskLevel}, risk_status = #{riskStatus}, estimated_arrival_time = #{estimatedArrivalTime}, evidence = #{evidence}, due_time = #{dueTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery_risk WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_risk SET risk_type = #{riskType}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, risk_status = #{riskStatus}, estimated_arrival_time = #{estimatedArrivalTime}, evidence = #{evidence}, risk_score = #{riskScore}, first_detected_time = #{firstDetectedTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.id FROM delivery d WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status IN ('pending_shipment', 'shipped', 'received', 'reship_pending')
mapper.sql: SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(r.id ORDER BY CASE r.risk_level WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, r.risk_score DESC), ',', 1) AS UNSIGNED) AS id, r.delivery_id, d.delivery_no, r.contract_id, c.title AS contract_title, CASE WHEN SUM(r.risk_level = 'high') > 0 THEN 'high' WHEN SUM(r.risk_level = 'medium') > 0 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS risk_level, CASE WHEN SUM(r.risk_status = 'high') > 0 THEN 'high' WHEN SUM(r.risk_status = 'disposing') > 0 THEN 'disposing' WHEN SUM(r.risk_status = 'warned') > 0 THEN 'warned' ELSE 'active' END AS risk_status, MAX(r.risk_score) AS risk_score, MAX(r.estimated_arrival_time) AS estimated_arrival_time, MAX(r.promised_delivery_date) AS promised_delivery_date, COUNT(*) AS risk_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.risk_type ORDER BY r.risk_type SEPARATOR ',') AS risk_types_raw FROM delivery_risk r JOIN delivery d ON d.id = r.delivery_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 JOIN contract c ON c.id = r.contract_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.risk_status IN ('active', 'warned', 'high', 'disposing')
